_README: Copy this file to loop-data/cache/training.json (gitignored; once the services run, the training document's copy: send edits with npm run documents -- push training) and replace these example days with your real program. Keys are ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD); a date with no entry renders as a rest / unprogrammed day. Each day has: kind ('gym' or 'run'), a short focus chip, and blocks. A block has an optional label (A/B/C…), a title, and lines. Then run `npm run generate`.
